name: draftfirst-web
description: Draft First — a private, local-first screenplay editor and document engine

scripts.check: npm run package:build && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run package:build && npm run test:app && npm run test:package
scripts.package:verify: npm run verify --workspace=@draftfirst/core && npm run pack:check --workspace=@draftfirst/core
scripts.quality: npm run check && npm test && npm run build && npm run package:verify && npm run package:smoke
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler@latest pages deploy build
